newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa says strike may delay freight.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa says strike may delay freight.

text.p: Air cargo movements out of Frankfurt airport could be delayed by a pilots' and ground handling workers' strike on Thursday even though freighter pilots are not expected to strike, Lufthansa Cargo AG said.
It said freight for overseas destinations might face hold-ups if international flights were affected.

White-collar union DAG said it will hold a two-hour warning strike starting at 0530 GMT (0630 local) and called on all Lufthansa crew and ground handling staff at Frankfurt, Hamburg, Munich, Duesseldorf and Hanover airports to follow its call.
Lufthansa Cargo spokesman Dietrich Seidl said the airline did not expect its freighter pilots, who had separate contracts with the cargo airline, to join the passenger aircraft pilots' action.
But he added: "There could be some delays in ground handling. We would be affected if they strike on international flights but we must wait and see what happens."
